holidays.name: International Talk Like a Pirate Day (Observed Sept 19 normally)
holidays.description: Hold on, this one is a neighbor! On September 17 itself the pirate-adjacent fun is a warm-up: landlubbers practice their 'Arrr' and 'Ahoy' in advance.
holidays.origin: Talk Like a Pirate Day was created in 1995 by John Baur and Mark Summers during a racquetball game and is officially on September 19.
holidays.funFact: The holiday went global after humorist Dave Barry wrote about it in 2002.

holidays.name: Constitution Day and Citizenship Day (U.S.)
holidays.description: Americans commemorate the signing of the U.S. Constitution with readings, quizzes, and schoolroom lessons about civic duty. Some celebrate by trying to recite the Preamble from memory.
holidays.origin: The Constitution was signed on September 17, 1787, in Philadelphia. The observance was formalized by Congress in 2004, and was earlier known as Citizenship Day.
holidays.funFact: Schools receiving federal funds are required to teach about the Constitution on this day, and when the 17th falls on a weekend it is observed on a nearby weekday.

holidays.name: National Apple Dumpling Day
holidays.description: A day dedicated to the humble apple dumpling: a whole apple wrapped in pastry, baked until golden and bubbling, and served warm with cinnamon sauce or ice cream.
holidays.origin: A food holiday of unofficial origin, celebrating the fall apple harvest and a dessert that dates back centuries in English and American kitchens.
holidays.funFact: Apple dumplings were a popular dessert in colonial America, where cooks often wrapped them in cloth and boiled them instead of baking.

holidays.name: National Cheeseburger Day (Sept 18) Eve / Hamburger Honoring Day Warm-up: National Pet Rock Day Alternative - World Patient Safety Day
holidays.description: World Patient Safety Day raises awareness about preventing harm in healthcare, encouraging patients, families, and medical teams to speak up and double-check. It is a serious observance, but an important one.
holidays.origin: Established by the World Health Assembly in 2019 and led by the World Health Organization, with a new theme each year.
holidays.funFact: Landmarks around the world are lit up in orange each year to mark the day.

holidays.name: Answer the Telephone Like Buddy the Elf Day
holidays.description: Fans of the movie Elf answer every call with the cheerful greeting, 'Buddy the Elf, what's your favorite color?' Expect confusion from telemarketers and glee from your friends.
holidays.origin: A pop culture observance inspired by the 2003 holiday comedy Elf, in which Will Ferrell's character answers the phone with this signature line.
holidays.funFact: The scene was largely improvised, and Buddy's wide-eyed innocence helped make Elf one of the most rewatched holiday films ever.
